newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco treasurer to retire at end of term.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco treasurer to retire at end of term.

text.p: San Francisco Treasurer Mary Callanan has announced that she will not seek a fifth term in office.
Appointed in 1980 to serve as treasurer, Callanan has since been elected to four consecutive terms of office.
In a statement, Callanan said she would retire at the close of her current term, which ends in January.

As treasurer, Callanan has been responsible for collecting, managing and investing all San Francisco funds. She said she started with an investment portfolio of just $600 million and now invests almost $3 billion of city funds.
Callanan has worked for the city and county of San Francisco for more than 30 years, serving in the real estate department, controller's office and on the airport commission.
